QuestInfo.name: Love, Greater than Life
QuestInfo.0: You wake up Juliet with some medicine with the help of Russellon. Ask Juliet what she put in the food.
QuestInfo.1: It was definitely the ingredients. Juliet after waking asks you to deliver medicine to Romeo along with her heart felt apology.
QuestInfo.2: Romeo wakes after eating the medicine. He then says that he can eat that lunch over and over again since it was made by Juliet. This must be true love. Yulete wakes up but someone does not appear the same.

default.0: (You give her a shake but she doesn't respond.)

npc.0: I don't know if I can ever face Romeo again...
